sections.intro: GetSibu brings storage, organisation, AI tagging, search, collaboration, permissions and analytics into one platform.

layers.label: Storage

layers.label: Organisation

layers.label: AI tagging
layers.body: GetSibu can suggest tags during asset processing so that teams do not have to manually classify every file.

layers.label: Search
layers.body: GetSibu makes creative assets searchable through filenames, metadata, OCR, AI-generated tags, comments and semantic information.

layers.label: Collaboration
layers.body: GetSibu provides collaboration features directly inside the asset library so teams can discuss files without moving conversations into disconnected tools.

layers.label: Permissions
layers.body: GetSibu provides granular permissions so organisations can control who can access different areas of their creative library.

layers.label: Analytics
layers.body: GetSibu analytics provide visibility into uploads, comments, storage, contributors, tags and other library activity.

items.question: What Is GetSibu?
items.answer: GetSibu is an AI-aware digital asset management platform for storing, organising, searching and collaborating around videos, images, documents and audio.

items.question: Who Is GetSibu For?
items.answer: GetSibu is designed for production teams, marketing teams, agencies, brand teams, creative studios and other organisations managing large creative libraries.

sections.heading: The lifecycle of an asset
sections.intro: An asset's lifecycle can include ingestion, metadata processing, AI tagging, review, approval, distribution and archival.

stages.label: Ingestion
stages.body: GetSibu supports asset ingestion from connected storage sources and direct uploads.

stages.label: Metadata
stages.body: When assets enter GetSibu, the platform processes available metadata and prepares them for search and organisation.

stages.label: AI tagging
stages.body: GetSibu can suggest tags during asset processing so that teams do not have to manually classify every file.

stages.label: Review
stages.body: Creative review provides a central location for teams to inspect work, discuss changes and confirm final assets.

stages.label: Approval
stages.body: Assets can move through an approval process with status history, creating a clear record of whether content is awaiting review, approved or requires changes.

stages.label: Archival
stages.body: Archiving provides a way to retain historical content without allowing old material to interfere with everyday asset discovery.

stages.label: Process
stages.body: After upload, assets move through processing stages such as metadata extraction, thumbnail generation and AI-related processing.

stages.label: Understand
stages.body: AI media understanding allows GetSibu to interpret the content of visual assets and make that information available through search and organisation workflows.

stages.label: Suggest tags
stages.body: GetSibu can suggest tags during asset processing so that teams do not have to manually classify every file.

stages.label: Review
stages.body: Teams can approve suggested tags in bulk, making large-scale asset organisation significantly faster than reviewing every file individually.

stages.label: Discover
stages.body: AI asset discovery helps users find files based on what appears inside the asset rather than depending entirely on manually entered metadata.

body.text: Duplicate detection combines exact and perceptual hashing to identify identical files and visually equivalent copies, including cases where a file has been re-encoded or renamed.
